name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core table convention), descriptor spell_ap_boost_factor accurately names role (AP-boost spell/item multiplier 0.15). Suffix _015 is a value tag (the constant 0.15), NOT a Ghidra address residual: the home address is 0x50210 and does not appear in the name. Consistent with sibling naming data_fd2_battle_spell_dp_boost_factor_015 (DP 0.15) and data_fd2_battle_ai_enemy_spell_score_multiplier_15 (1.5). 'factor' communicates the scalar/multiplier data-type role. No address residual, no missing domain ID.
purpose: AP-boost spell/item multiplier constant 0.15: scales the buffed unit's current wAP to compute the AP increase delta for the AP-boost spell/item effect.
logic_summary: Single READ from fd2_cast_ap_boost_spell (load site 0x227df). Per buffed target (when not already boosted): delta = trunc_toward_zero(1 + wAP * 0.15); asm FILD wAP, FMUL qword [0x50210], FADD 1, then __CHP truncates toward zero. delta is shown as a damage number (glyph 'i'=0x69) and added to wAP; XP credit accrues level_mod*2. No writers anywhere (the reader mutates only wAP/status fields, never this constant).
element_semantics: Scalar fixed multiplier 0.15 applied to a unit's AP to derive the AP-boost delta (delta = trunc(1 + AP*0.15)).
notes: Memory @ 0x50210 = 33 33 33 33 33 33 c3 3f (LE) = 0x3FC3333333333333 = 0.15, matching src comment exactly. Ghidra datatype confirmed double. Single xref READ from 0x227df in fd2_cast_ap_boost_spell; no writers, so const is correct. btltab.c comment was already accurate and concise (purpose, reader, FILD/FMUL/+1/truncate semantics, no-writers, IEEE754 value) -> comment kept, btltab.c NOT modified. Ghidra data plate was empty (null) -> created a concise PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline reflecting the src conclusion (PLATE_COMMENT field per data-plate mechanism).
